message:
Update torch-xpu-ops commit pin (#198200)

Update the torch-xpu-ops commit to [intel/torch-xpu-ops@e0680d](https://github.com/intel/torch-xpu-ops/commit/e0680d8e93c3d2289217149dc2e0ecb2cff844ad).

New features:

- Port stateless Philox RNG operations `_philox_normal_xpu_` and `_philox_uniform_xpu_` to XPU backend
- Support Float4_e2m1fn_x2 and Float8_e8m0fnu for xccl non-reduction ops
- Enable oneMKL sparse in the build system

Fixes/Refine:

- Fix `mha_bwd` empty-batch abort in flash attention backward
- Return BSHD-contiguous input grads from XPU efficient attention backward
- Decouple attention dropout mask reconstruction from the XPU generator

SYCL free function migration:

- Migrate a large batch of kernels to SYCL free function style: UnfoldBackward, NaNCheck, Transpose, SparseCsrTensorAdd, PhiloxKeySplit, TriangularOps, TensorShape, TensorApply, SummaryOps, RangeFactories, PsRoiPool, PsRoiAlign, FusedObsFakeQuant, MaxUnpooling, Im2col, FractionalMaxPool2d/3d, FunctionOfAMatrixUtils, FFTKernelFunctor, DilatedMaxPool3d, AveragePool2d, AdaptiveAveragePooling3d, WeightNorm, ComputeMode, Dequant_int4, WelfordNorm, Sorting, Embedding, NMS, MultiMarginLoss, Norm
Pull Request resolved: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/198200
Approved by: https://github.com/EikanWang
